title: Internet service interruption - Glen William North, NSW
current_summary:
Affected area: Glen William North, NSW. The issue began at about 8:39 pm on 13 November 2026 (AEDT) and services were restored at about 9:41 pm the same evening.

Resolution: Fault caused by approved 3rd party network provider planned works

Services in your area have been restored following an unexpected network issue. If your service has not reconnected automatically, try restarting your Wi-Fi router and nbn Connection Box (if you have one).

cause.reason: An unexpected issue in the access network serving the area.
